promise: Make Bard more widely available to the public in the coming weeks
description: Pichai announced trusted-tester access on February 6, 2023 and wider public access in coming weeks. Google began US and UK public early access on March 21, 2023.
evidence: Google's February 6 announcement distinguishes immediate testing from later public access.
Google announced public early access March 21.

review.note: Trusted testers opened February 6; 'coming weeks' referred to wider public access. March 31 is an inferred cutoff, not an announced date.
